title: Fluxgraph — Sankey Flow Studio
description: Type flows as plain text, get a publishable Sankey diagram — drag the nodes, restyle it, download PNG, SVG, JSON or CSV.
concept: Fluxgraph turns three comma-separated columns into a real Sankey diagram. A longest-path pass assigns each node a stage, ten barycenter sweeps untangle the ribbons, and every node stays draggable so you can override the automatic stacking by hand. Five starter datasets, five palettes and a full geometry panel cover the styling; the export tab writes a 2x PNG, a real vector SVG, a structured JSON model or the raw CSV, and the whole document round-trips through a share link.
features: Live text editor: 'source, target, value' per line, plus 'A -> B: 12' syntax, # comments and per-line error reporting
Automatic Sankey layout — longest-path staging, cycle-safe, barycenter crossing reduction, auto-shrinking gaps
Drag any node vertically to re-stack the column; ribbons re-sort to follow, and 'Reset dragged nodes' restores the solver
Five starter datasets (funnel, energy, budget, carbon, recycling) and a quick-add row for new flows
Style panel: node width, gap, ribbon curve and opacity sliders, five palettes, gradient ribbons, labels, values, light canvas, sink alignment
Hover a node for in/out totals and share-of-total, or a ribbon for its own value
Export 2x PNG, true vector SVG, structured JSON and raw CSV — every download verified non-empty
localStorage autosave plus a named diagram library, and a base64url share link that restores flows, style and drag offsets
tech: Canvas 2D ribbon renderer with cubic-bezier flow bands and per-link horizontal gradients
Sankey solver: bounded longest-path depth assignment (cycle-safe), column value scaling with auto-shrinking gaps, ten-sweep barycenter crossing reduction
Analytic bezier sampling for ribbon hit-testing — no second hit canvas, transform-independent
Pointer Events node dragging with offsets persisted per node name
Shared label-fitting pass (binary-search ellipsis against the inter-column lane) so canvas and SVG output agree
Hand-written SVG serializer with userSpaceOnUse linear gradients and paint-order text haloes
canvas.toBlob 2x PNG export, Blob downloads for SVG / JSON / CSV
localStorage autosave + named library, base64url URL-hash document sharing
ResizeObserver-driven DPR-aware resizing, requestAnimationFrame draw coalescing

interaction.mouse: Hover a node for inflow, outflow and share-of-total; hover a ribbon for its value. Hovering dims every unrelated flow.
interaction.click: Drag a node up or down to re-stack its column by hand; release to save. Buttons drive presets, palettes and exports.
interaction.touch: Everything runs on Pointer Events, so nodes drag under a finger. 'Editor' collapses the panel to give the diagram the full screen.
interaction.keyboard: r resets dragged nodes, g toggles gradient ribbons, l toggles labels, p exports a PNG, Esc clears the highlight.
